verdict.rationale: The only pricing evidence describes a free tier of '1 cluster per user, upgrade to paid anytime.' That is cluster-based and gives no documented serverless, usage-based pricing or transparent per-unit costs. Pricing model is a fair axis for a vector database with a managed cloud offering, so the absence of evidence yields 'none', not 'na'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pay serverless usage-based pricing with transparent per-unit costs instead of provisioning fixed clusters
